claim: A web ACL (protection pack) can protect Amazon CloudFront, Amazon API Gateway, Application Load Balancer, AWS AppSync, Amazon Cognito, AWS App Runner, AWS Amplify, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and AWS Verified Access resources; for API Gateway the protected resource type is the REST API.
question: Which AWS resource types can an AWS WAF web ACL protect?

values.display: Amazon CloudFront, Amazon API Gateway, Application Load Balancer
AWS AppSync, Amazon Cognito, AWS App Runner

evidence.quote: You can protect Amazon CloudFront, Amazon API Gateway, Application Load Balancer, AWS AppSync, Amazon Cognito, AWS App Runner, AWS Amplify, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway, and AWS Verified Access resources.

note: d002, d003 (register-08). The condition is the registrar's reading of an exhaustive list, not an AWS sentence: write 'is not in the supported list', never 'AWS WAF cannot attach to an NLB' as a quoted fact.
